summary: Verified fix for '12+ age category empty in Ugeplaner/Schedules' bug caused by unencoded '+' in query string being decoded as space server-side. Confirmed encodeURIComponent() fix applied in schedule.tsx and schedule-slot-form.tsx resolves the issue at both API and UI level. All 4 requested tests + regression sanity passed.
critical_code_review_comments: Root cause confirmed via direct curl: GET /api/schedule-slots?age_category=12+&day_of_week=mandag returns 0 results (unencoded '+' decoded as space by FastAPI/Starlette), while ?age_category=12%2B&day_of_week=mandag correctly returns 5 results. Fix (encodeURIComponent) in schedule.tsx line 42 and schedule-slot-form.tsx line 57 resolves this correctly.
No regression found in day_of_week encoding either (day names like 'lørdag'/'søndag' contain non-ASCII chars, also correctly encoded now).
seed_data_creation: None. Test 2 (copy feature) used existing real data (Sif's 2-4 category 07:00 UVB-lys+Varmelampe task), copied to 12+ category. Verified via DB query that final slot counts per day for both 2-4 (5,5,5,5,5,5,5) and 12+ (5,6,5,5,5,6,5) categories remained at their expected baseline values after the copy test - no duplicates or data corruption introduced, so no cleanup was necessary.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Bug fix fully verified and working. TEST 1: All 7 days for '12+' category now show correct task counts (mandag=5, tirsdag=6, onsdag=5, torsdag=5, fredag=5, lørdag=6, søndag=5) matching expected DB values, confirmed both via curl (encoded vs unencoded '+') and via Playwright UI walkthrough of the Ugeplaner tab. TEST 2: Copy feature verified working - opened edit form on a 2-4 category task, opened 'Kopier til...' sheet, selected '12+ måneder' as additional target age category via testID 'copy-to-days-age-12+', saved, got success toast 'Opgave kopieret til 1 dage × 2 perioder', and confirmed via API that 12+ mandag task list correctly reflects the copy without any count discrepancy or duplication. TEST 3: Other 3 categories (2-4, 4-7, 7-12) all show tasks correctly for mandag (no regression). TEST 4: Editing an existing 12+ task correctly loaded its category (Lys & Varme), time (07:00), and items (UVB-lys, Varmelampe) into the form - confirming the GET-with-age_category=12+ fix works for edit mode too. Daily Overview (Dagsoversigt) tab regression-checked visually, shows Sif's (2-4) tasks correctly as before (unaffected by this bug, as expected). No issues found. Fix is complete and correct.
